description: The Enum.reduce operator-ref telemetry survey shows fz2 interp drives to LowerBackendProgram(root), but jobs/backend.rs unconditionally follows a changed runtime BackendProgram with LowerNativeProgram(root). run_root_interp consumes BackendProgram and does not read NativeProgram, so this violates the spreadsheet-style demand rule: produce only the fact demanded by the consumer. Signal: fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz produced LowerNativeProgram x1 and NativeProgram x1 on an interpreter run. Strategy: remove the unconditional backend->native follow_up, and make native consumers explicitly demand LowerNativeProgram through compile_root_jit/run_root_jit/compile_root_aot. Add telemetry/job-count regression coverage that interp reaches BackendProgram and leaves NativeProgram absent.
title: Compiler2 backend-only roots should not enqueue native lowering
